title: 第5章 这个面子你得给我第6章 真寂往事
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
;;
三日后，暮鼓刚过。
真玄还在破妄禅院中翻阅一本某位化劲期执事递交上来的创新武学研发路径，却是越看越头大。
这位执事的想法可谓是天马行空，完了却半点落地的可能都没有，比他前世见过的ppt大师都还离谱，让他不禁怀疑这特么是不是来混贡献点的。
门外忽然传来一阵沉稳的脚步声。
这脚步不急不缓，每一步都踏得极实，像是踩在人心口上。
真玄嘴角上扬，师兄的步子他熟得很。
果然，门外响起真恒的声音：“真玄，可曾歇下？”
“师兄请进。”真玄放下书卷，起身相迎。
真恒推门而入，依旧是那件半旧的灰色僧袍，面容儒雅温润，手中却多了一封未曾封口的信笺。
他在蒲团上坐下，看了一眼真玄，目光中带着几分打量。
“境界稳固得如何了？”
“尚可。”真玄如实道，“抱丹初成，真元运转之间还有些滞涩，约莫还需半年光景才能彻底稳固。”
真恒点了点头，沉默片刻，忽然道：“真寂想见你。”
真玄微微一怔。
“他托我来传话，”真恒的语气很平静，“说是想与你单独谈谈。”
“谈什么？”
“大约还是寺规的事。”真恒叹了口气。
“真寂这个人你是知道的，性子倔，认死理。
他在持戒堂坐了十二年，十二年来真如寺上下一千七百余名弟子，犯戒者不过三十七人，其中大半还是无心之失。

这份功绩，放眼真如寺开寺以来，也是数得着的。”
真玄没有接话。
他知道真恒还有下文。
果然，真恒续道：
“但他也有他的执念，这些年我看在眼里。
真寂对你那些......嗯，破格之举，反应之所以如此激烈，未必全是因为寺规。
他心中有事，一直没放下。”
真玄抬起头，看着真恒的眼睛。
“师兄的意思是？”
“我的意思是，”真恒的目光深邃而平和，“不管你怎么想，你都得去见见他。”
然后指了指自己，“这个面子你得给我。”
真玄心里暗道一声“好家伙”，随即点了点头。
“好。何时？”
“就今晚吧。他在持戒堂等你。”

Three days later, the evening drum had just passed.
Zhenxuan was still flipping through a book of innovative martial arts research and development paths submitted by a certain Hua Jinqi deacon in the Powan Zen Monastery, but the more he read, the more he became confused.
This deacon's idea was so wild and unbridled that it had no chance of landing at all. It was even more outrageous than the ppt masters he had seen in his previous life. He couldn't help but wonder if this was just to make some contribution points.
Suddenly there was a steady sound of footsteps outside the door.
The pace was neither hasty nor slow, and every step was very solid, as if stepping on the heart's heart.
The corners of Zhenxuan's mouth raised. He was very familiar with his senior brother's steps.
Sure enough, Zhen Heng's voice sounded outside the door: "Zhen Xuan, have you ever rested?"
"Senior brother, please come in." Zhenxuan put down the book and stood up to greet him.
Zhenheng pushed the door open and walked in. He was still wearing the old gray monk's robe, his face was elegant and gentle, but there was an unsealed letter in his hand.
He sat down on the futon and glanced at Zhenxuan, with a somewhat appraising look in his eyes.
"How stable is the realm?"
"It's acceptable." Zhenxuan said matter-of-factly, "Baodan has just been completed, and there is still some stagnation in the movement of the true energy. It will take about half a year to be completely stable."
Zhen Heng nodded, remained silent for a moment, and suddenly said: "Zhen Ji wants to see you."
Zhenxuan was slightly startled.
"He asked me to send a message," Zhen Heng said in a calm tone, "He said he wanted to talk to you alone."
"What to talk about?"
"It's probably still a matter of temple rules." Zhen Heng sighed.
"You know Zhenji, he has a stubborn temper and accepts death.
He sat in the Precepts Hall for twelve years. During these twelve years, there were more than 1,700 disciples in Zhenru Temple. Only thirty-seven of them violated the precepts, and most of them were unintentional mistakes.
This achievement is unparalleled even if we look at Zhenru Temple since its opening. "
Zhenxuan didn't answer.
He knew there was more to Zhenheng.
Sure enough, Zhen Heng continued:
“But he also has his obsession, and I’ve seen it over the years.
The reason why Zhenji reacted so violently to your...well, unusual actions may not all be because of the temple rules.
He had something on his mind and he never let it go. "
Zhenxuan raised his head and looked into Zhenheng's eyes.
"What do you mean, senior brother?"
"What I mean is," Zhen Heng's eyes were deep and peaceful, "No matter what you think, you have to go see him."
Then he pointed at himself and said, "You have to give me this face."
Zhenxuan secretly said "Good guy" in his heart, and then nodded.
"Okay. When?"
"Just tonight. He is waiting for you at the Precept Hall."
